historical_references.reference: Frederika, the daughter of King Christian III of Denmark and Norway, was born on October 15, 1571. She was named after her maternal grandmother, Queen Frederica of Denmark, who was the elder sister of Holy Roman Emperor Ferdinand I.

Frederika, a Swedish queen consort, was born in 1505 as the daughter of Duke Eric of Sweden. She married Christian II of Denmark in 1515 and became Queen of Denmark and Norway. She was later known as 'Frederica of Denmark' in Denmark and 'Kristina of Sweden' in Sweden. Her reign was marked by the Danish-Swedish War of 1520, which ended with the signing of the Treaty of Malmö in 1520.
